component: return_progress prompt_progress stream events, POST /tokenize, POST /apply-template
modifications: No Splash code copied; the wire semantics (per-protocol carrier events, strictly increasing processed, non-streaming rejection, prompt-only endpoints) follow Splash's documented behavior.
Progress is derived from mlx2's existing prompt responses in whole-prompt coordinates and coalesced to one queued event per job instead of Splash's per-request callback validation.
Payload keys are processed/total/cached/replay/time_ms (Splash: total/cache/processed/time_ms); replay is reserved for preempt-and-replay recovery.

/tokenize renders a Chat or Completions request through the adapter's admission prompt_tokens and returns {tokens, count, max_model_len}; Splash's raw {content, add_special} tokenization is not implemented.
/apply-template uses an optional adapter render_prompt(request) -> str with encode(text) == prompt_tokens; adapters without it return 501.
validation: CPU only; GPU serve smoke queued in the splash gpu-queue (13-progress-tokenize).
